properties.description: An id is established on first open and read on every one after, from the identity file beside the store's REAL directory (<real store>.id.json) — a sibling of the store, because the id namespaces every stored key and so must be known before the design can be read. However the path is spelled (a symlink, `--graph-path .`, a relative path), one store has one identity file: new ones are written beside the real directory, and the places reflow2 0.79.0 and earlier used for a symlink (beside the link) and for `.` (inside the store) are still read, an identity found only there being copied beside the store and never moved. An open settles identity before it writes anything, so a refusal leaves the store as it found it. Minted with zero coordination (creation nanosecond + process + absolute path through fnv1a, no dependency added); the friendly label is a changeable layer on top and never load-bearing. An unreadable identity is REFUSED, never defaulted, because defaulting opens a different design at the same path and reports nothing wrong. THE MIGRATION IS THE FEATURE: a store that already holds a design under the old shared id adopts that id forever, which is what keeps every existing export, chain link and committed record valid — graph_id is inside the export's content hash. Served as design_identity (read, or rename via label).
properties.name: A design is given a name nobody negotiates for, and keeps it
